Halo Run

Two songs. One pulse.

Catch each note as it reaches the halo. Any arrow key, Space, or a tap will do. Follow the pulse, build a streak.

One tap per note
All spokes share one input.
Timing & access

Perfect: within 60 ms. Good: within 120 ms. A missed note or an extra tap breaks the combo. Headphones can help you hear the beat; wireless audio may add delay.

If taps in time with the music read late, increase this value. It is subtracted from your tap time. P pauses; Escape returns to song choice. Reduced motion keeps notes fixed on the ring and shows a next-note countdown.
